summary_en: TeamSpirit authorized acquisition of up to 450,000 shares (2.96% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum 150 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 23, 2026 through April 30, 2027, as part of a new ongoing buyback program prioritizing growth investment while returning capital when cash reserves are sufficient at period-end.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
TeamSpirit's board of directors has authorized the company to acquire up to 450,000 of its ordinary shares for a maximum total of 150 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 23, 2026 (on or after receipt of the audit report and confirmation of FY2026 August financial results) through April 30, 2027. This represents the initial tranche of a newly established ongoing share buyback program.

The company introduced this buyback program as part of its capital allocation policy, which prioritizes growth investment while allowing for share repurchases when cash reserves remain substantial at the fiscal period-end. The 450,000 shares correspond to 2.96% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026. The acquired shares will be retained for potential use in employee stock compensation schemes or M&A activities, with details of deployment decisions to be announced separately.

The authorization reflects the company's intention to enhance shareholder value through improved capital efficiency while maintaining flexibility to fund strategic growth investments in the upcoming fiscal period.
